baseline.canonical_format: UTF-8 compact JSON plus LF; Git ls-tree order; rows [path, Git mode, blob OID, full working permission mode in octal, byte length, raw working SHA256]

closing.opening_row_reconstitution: After removing the temporary duplicate inventory, reconstituted the exact rows from the baseline public Git tree/current bytes only after their canonical digest equalled the frozen opening digest. Every old row is again compared individually before and after commit.
closing.original_private_files: Not read or written; outside this public checkout comparison scope.
closing.scope: Every old PublicGit tracked entry compared individually to its opening raw bytes/length/mode/hash and index tuple. Summary retained; duplicate baseline rows removed before commit.

commit_policy.final_commit_hash: Reported in final console output; not embedded in its own committed bytes.
commit_policy.post_commit_verification: Actual old per-file comparisons and clean status run after commit; final console output is separate from this precommit record.

reader_note: First baseline reader assumed raw working bytes equal Git blobs and stopped before any write at tools/windows/openergy-run.cmd. Public check-attr reports text/eol=crlf. Corrected reader retains actual raw bytes and compares them to their opening samples, independently of Git normalization; no tracked file changed.
